name: Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal
role: Former home minister linked to security-force accountability debates
contribution: As Bangladesh's home minister during major protest, election, and security-crackdown periods, he became a central political figure in debates over policing, border-force deployment, arrests, and state accountability.
context: Security governance under the Awami League government, the 2018 protest-control and election period, and July-August 2024 crackdown accountability debates.
impact: His tenure is tied to public arguments over whether security agencies were used to suppress dissent and how command responsibility should be assessed after the 2024 uprising.
highlight: A senior security-policy figure in the former government, later named in reporting on the 2024 crackdown accountability debate.
seoTitle: Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal - Security Crackdown and Accountability Profile
seoDescription: Profile of Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal, former Bangladesh home minister linked to security governance, protest-control, and 2024 crackdown accountability debates.
shortAnswer: Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal was Bangladesh's home minister during major security and protest-control periods, and later became a central figure in 2024 crackdown accountability debates.

faq.question: Why is Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal included in this timeline?
faq.answer: He is included because he was home minister during major protest-control and security-crackdown periods, and because later reporting on the OHCHR fact-finding report placed him in the 2024 accountability debate.
